newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks firm after brief consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks firm after brief consolidation.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed firmer after consolidating in morning trade and finding firm support. Traders said the market took its cue from a rise in Wall Street and U.S. bonds following a surprise drop in U.S. payrolls. * General index rose 1.79 points, 0.48 percent, to 372.27. * Ibex-35 index gained 22.44 points, 0.53 percent, to 4,266.30. * Telefonica rose 25 pesetas to 2,430 with 4.8 million shares traded while Repsol gained 35 pesetas to 4,410 with just under 500,000 shares exchanging hands.
Traders said demand was selective and the tone cautious as the Madrid bourse neared its historic high of 375.25.

"The market proved to be quite resistant to a fall this morning and it was easy to reverse the tendency, although the levels reached are weighing down on the market and rebounds are difficult," a trader said.
Volume was 44.8 billion pesetas, of which Telefonica accounted for 11.6 billion, Iberdrola 3.9 billion and Endesa 2.5 billion.
Banco Popular was one of the biggest gainers, rising 500 pesetas, 2.09 percent, to 24,400 pesetas. Pryca recovered some of Thursday's losses, rising 40 pesetas to 3,040 pesetas.
